data: Real Copernicus UA 2018 revised and official change 2018-2021
positive_label: 2018 eligible parcel intersects strict built conversion at >=100m² and >=1% of parcel area
neighbor_features: fraction of 2018 developed-category polygon representative points within a fixed radius divided by count of all 2018 polygon representative points within radius; unweighted by polygon area
selection: fixed parameter models; no tuning on test
cautions: BN associations do not imply causation
